name: lacirstat-teste
description: Calculadora modular para capacitacao pratica em testes estatisticos

scripts.pretest: npm run catalog:validate && npm run pipeline:test
scripts.test:run: npm run catalog:validate && npm run pipeline:test && vitest run
scripts.gate: npm run test:run && npm run build
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks || echo 'AVISO: nao foi possivel configurar core.hooksPath — os hooks locais (pre-commit/pre-push) NAO estao ativos neste clone. O gate local esta desligado; rode manualmente: git config core.hooksPath .githooks' 1>&2
scripts.pipeline:reconcile-gate: cd pipeline/sih && uv run pytest tests/test_reconcile_gate.py -x -q
scripts.pipeline:enumerate: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli enumerate
scripts.pipeline:download: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli download
scripts.pipeline:collect: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli collect
scripts.pipeline:aggregate: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli aggregate
scripts.pipeline:population: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli population
scripts.pipeline:reconcile: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli reconcile
scripts.pipeline:upload: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli upload
scripts.pipeline:partitions: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli partitions
scripts.pipeline:oracle-scrape: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli oracle-scrape
scripts.pipeline:audit: cd pipeline/sih && uv run python -m sih_pipeline.cli audit
